dedupe_keys.name: san diego bay baywide eelgrass inventories 1993 2023 us navy and port of san diego

description: A series of baywide surveys of eelgrass, the protected seagrass habitat of San Diego Bay, run by the US Navy and the San Diego Unified Port District since 1993 and carried out lately by Merkel & Associates. Contents: maps of eelgrass extent, area by depth band and by bay ecoregion for each survey year (1993, 1999, 2004, 2008, 2011, 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023), and an occurrence frequency map for 1993 to 2020. The 2023 survey mapped 2,595 acres, almost unchanged from 2,598 acres in 2020 after a 53.5% rise from 2017. Methods: hull-mounted 468 kHz interferometric sidescan sonar with RTK GPS over 19 survey days, drone orthophotos of shallow areas, and ROV and drop camera ground-truthing, digitised in GIS into one shapefile per year. Coverage: the whole of San Diego Bay, a busy naval and commercial port. Format and access: free PDF reports and poster maps on the Port of San Diego monitoring reports page; the GIS layers were prepared for the Navy and Port District and are not posted. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the reports say the maps are for planning and resource management, not project-specific impact assessment or navigation. Useful for adaptation and capacity planning at ports, where dredging, fill and new berths must avoid or mitigate eelgrass. It relates to the BGS marine geoscience archive in the catalogue.
